overview_description.description: Anfas Medical Care is a hospital for patients with lung problems requiring mechanical ventilation. They offer laboratory services, long-term care, palliative care, radiology services, respiratory therapy, ICU care, rehabilitation, urgent care, home health care, and dialysis care. They provide pre-analytical testing services, a clinical chemistry department, an immunology and serology section, diagnostic microbiology tests, and blood products.

about_short_description.short_description: Anfas Medical Care offers palliative care, radiology services, respiratory therapy, and dialysis care.

product.name: Respiratory Therapy
product.description: Provides diagnosis and treatment for lung and respiratory conditions, including rare cases, using advanced techniques.

product.name: Radiology Services
product.description: Offers a wide range of imaging services for inpatients, focusing on accurate diagnosis with advanced technology.

product.name: Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation
product.description: Enhances recovery through short-term or long-term care plans, focusing on improving movement and functional ability.

product.name: Dialysis Care
product.description: Provides dialysis services for patients with chronic kidney diseases, including those in intensive care, using modern equipment.

product.name: Extended Care
product.description: Offers long-term care for patients with chronic illnesses or disabilities, focusing on improving functional recovery and quality of life.

product.name: Intensive Care Unit
product.description: Provides comprehensive care for critical conditions with 24/7 consultant coverage and advanced medical equipment.
